WITH w AS (
  SELECT o.web_order_id, o.status, o.fulfilment_type, o.line_count,
    CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS order_date_hki,
    CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date_hki
  FROM fact_web_order o
)
SELECT status,
  COUNT(*) AS orders, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS distinct_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_date_hki BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ordered_in_range,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dispatch_date_hki BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dispatched_in_range,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_date_hki BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND dispatch_date_hki IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ordered_no_dispatch
FROM w GROUP BY ALL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_receipt_line,
 COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS etl_stamps, MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS min_etl, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS max_etl, MAX(sale_date) AS max_sale_date
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, s.store_id, p.category,
    CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) ELSE f.sale_date END AS recog_date,
    (s.store_id=900) AS is_web,
    CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', f.sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS ts_date, f.sale_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND s.store_id=900
)
SELECT is_web, staff_purchase_flag, (category='ZZ Test') AS test_art, (store_id=999) AS training,
  COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts, SUM(net_amount) AS net,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ts_date<>sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS date_mismatch,
  SUM(CASE WHEN recog_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_recog
FROM lines
WHERE recog_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, s.store_id, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND s.store_id<900
),
r AS (
  SELECT SUM(receipts) AS rpt_receipts, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_net_before_returns
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND store_id<900
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts_by_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (store_id, receipt_id)) AS receipts_by_store_id,
  SUM(net_amount) AS net_all_incl_staff, r.rpt_receipts, r.rpt_net_before_returns,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN receipt_id END) AS staff_receipts,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN receipt_id END) AS test_receipts_in_stores
FROM l CROSS JOIN r GROUP BY r.rpt_receipts, r.rpt_net_before_returns

SELECT SUM(receipts) AS rpt_web_receipts, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_web_net_before_returns
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND store_id=900

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount,
    CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900
         THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
         ELSE f.sale_date END AS recognition_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999
    AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year,
       ROUND(SUM(net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM lines
WHERE recognition_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, (s.store_id = 900) AS is_web,
    CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900
         THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
         ELSE f.sale_date END AS recognition_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
    AND s.store_id <> 999
    AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year,
       ROUND(SUM(net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), 2) AS atv,
       SUM(net_amount) AS net, COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts, COUNT(DISTINCT (is_web, receipt_id)) AS receipts_by_channel
FROM lines
WHERE recognition_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
